crossRefs.note: To what purpose does frankincense from Sheba come to me, and the sweet cane from a far country? Your burnt offerings…
“What are the multitude of your sacrifices to me?”, says Yahweh. “I have had enough of the burnt offerings of rams and…
As for the sacrifices of my offerings, they sacrifice meat and eat it; But Yahweh doesn’t accept them. Now he will…
I hate, I despise your feasts, and I can’t stand your solemn assemblies.

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel says: “Add your burnt offerings to your sacrifices and eat meat.
translations.bsb: This is what the LORD of Hosts, the God of Israel, says: Add your burnt offerings to your other sacrifices and eat the meat yourselves!
translations.kjv: Thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Put your burnt offerings unto your sacrifices, and eat flesh.
translations.asv: Thus saith Jehovah of hosts, the God of Israel: Add your burnt-offerings unto your sacrifices, and eat ye flesh.
